name: vscode
one_liner: The free, open-source code editor most professional developers already use every day — this is the underlying source code, not a new product.
buyer: No direct buyer — it's the editor itself; there's no new business opportunity in the base project beyond what already exists (extensions, forks).
business_use_cases: A company builds and sells a specialized fork or extension pack targeting a niche such as embedded systems or legal-tech coding.
A training company teaches 'VS Code mastery' workshops for enterprise developer onboarding.
An extension developer sells a premium VS Code extension through the marketplace.

money_ideas.idea: Paid premium VS Code extension sold through the marketplace.
Corporate developer-productivity training workshops centered on VS Code.

steal_this: There's nothing new to build from the base editor itself this weekend; the real opportunity is a niche extension, not the editor.
